title: Figure 28. Titan Simulation Results with Best-Fit Shaping Constants
description: Semi-log line graph titled "Titan IV Random-Attitude Failures through 300 sec" plotting Percent in 5-deg sector (%) versus Angle From Flight Path (deg). Simulated malfunction-turn impact data are compared with theoretical curves for A = 2.70, B = 10,000; A = 3.15, B = 2,000; A = 3.25, B = 1,000; and A = 3.50, B = 1,000. Captioned "Figure 28. Titan Simulation Results with Best-Fit Shaping Constants".
